7.2.4.11.9 Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData
[SWS_Rte_05316] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRx
Data_<CGI> ⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI>
Syntax
BufReq_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
const PduInfoType* info,
PduLengthType* bufferSizePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0108
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API
Parameters (in)
info
Provides the source buffer (SduDataPtr) and the number of bytes
to be copied (SduLength). An SduLength of 0 can be used to
query the current amount of available buffer in the upper layer
module. In this case, the SduDataPtr may be a NULL_PTR.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
bufferSizePtr
Available receive buffer after data has been copied.
Return value
BufReq_ReturnType
BUFREQ_OK: Data copied successfully.
BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: Data was not copied because an error
occurred.
▽
△
Description
Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData provides the RTE Implementation Plug-In with the received data
of an I-PDU segment from the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring
transformation. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom_TP Rte_LdCom
CbkCopyRxData callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00692] for more details on the
functionality of this callback.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
